recommended_manual_source_export.instructions: Open Matlink Farm performance report -> Data tab -> choose selected dates -> HR -> download, preserve both filtered and unfiltered originals and the selected UI options.

data_use_restrictions: Do not convert volume reported in Mcf directly to dry normalized Nm3
Do not accept source-reported efficiency percent as validated without meter quality investigation
Do not synthesize missing gas volume from electric energy or vice versa
Do not assume all 91 monitored points are independent calibrated continuous energy meters
Do not assume timestamp local DST conversion is gap-free, one-to-one or equivalent to UTC
Do not transfer Matlink engine constraints to Swedish synthetic CHP or 440kWe Polish landfill installation
Do not commit raw material until licensing and permission are established
Do not treat published hourly outputs as seconds-scale ramp or safe minimum load tests
next_evidence_gate: Secure authorized raw CSV and usage rights, preserve source bytes/SHA256 and filter metadata, audit time zone/DST and exact energy meter definitions, review calibrations before model fitting.
